class View:
    def __init__(self):
        self.rows = []  # accepted rows
        self.notes = {}  # job_id -> note
        self.loading = False
        self.error = None
        self.seq = 0      # monotonically increasing request id
        self._latest_id = None  # id of the most recent begun request that hasn't been finished yet
        self._finished = False   # True after first valid finish
    
    def begin(self, query):
        """Return a monotonically increasing request id.
        Clears loading errors but keeps existing rows until a valid finish.
        """
        self.seq += 1
        request_id = self.seq
        self._latest_id = request_id
        self.loading = False
        self.error = None
        return request_id
    
    def finish(self, request_id, rows):
        """If request_id matches the latest begun request and no previous finish has been accepted,
        accept rows, copy them, and return True. Otherwise return False.
        """
        # If a finish already happened (i.e., _finished is True), any subsequent finish is stale
        if self._finished:
            return False
        
        # Only the latest begun request can update rows, once.
        if request_id != self._latest_id:
            return False
        
        # Accept the rows (copy them) and mark that a finish has been accepted.
        self._finished = True
        self.rows = rows[:]  # copy
        self.loading = False
        self.error = None
        return True
    
    def __repr__(self):
        return f'View(rows={self.rows}, notes={self.notes}, loading={self.loading}, error={self.error}, seq={self.seq}, latest_id={self._latest_id}, finished={self._finished})'
